# Queue configuration

| Setting | Default | Valid range | Behavior |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `visibilitySeconds` | 45 | 5–600 | Time before an unacknowledged job is visible again |
| `maxAttempts` | 3 | 1–8 | Includes the first delivery attempt |
| `backoffMs` | 400 | 100–5000 | Base delay between retry attempts |
| `deadLetterAfter` | 8 | 1–20 | Failed jobs moved to the dead-letter queue |

- `maxAttempts` counts the initial delivery.
- A value of `1` disables retries.
- Authentication errors (`401` and `403`) are never retried, even when `maxAttempts` is greater than one.

```yaml
queue:
  maxAttempts: 4
  backoffMs: 800
```

Configuration changes take effect after the worker restarts.

`visibilitySeconds` is measured in seconds; `backoffMs` is measured in milliseconds.

import subprocess
import sys

SCRIPT = ".agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py"
CMDS = [
    ["audit", "input.md", "--level", "3", "--scope=format"],
    ["audit", "output.md", "--level", "3", "--scope=format"],
    ["fmt", "output.md"],
    ["verify", "input.md", "output.md", "--scope=format"],
    ["report", "input.md", "output.md", "--scope=format", "--level=3"],
]

for args in CMDS:
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SCRIPT, *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
    print("=" * 70)
    print(f"$ adhd_md.py {' '.join(args)}")
    print(f"exit={proc.returncode}")
    print(proc.stdout.strip())
    if proc.stderr.strip():
        print("--- stderr ---")
        print(proc.stderr.strip())

input.content:
import re
import unicodedata

orig = open("input.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
new = open("output.md", encoding="utf-8").read()


def squash(text, strip_bullets=False):
    lines = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if strip_bullets:
            line = re.sub(r"^\s*-\s+", "", line)
        lines.append(line)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", "", "".join(lines))


a, b = squash(orig), squash(new, strip_bullets=True)
print("char-exact (whitespace/markup aside):", a == b)
if a != b:
    for i, (x, y) in enumerate(zip(a, b)):
        if x != y:
            print("first difference at", i, repr(a[i - 40:i + 40]), "VS", repr(b[i - 40:i + 40]))
            break
    print("len", len(a), len(b))

# every number, unit and literal-bearing line from the source must still appear
for probe in ["45", "5–600", "3", "1–8", "400", "100–5000", "8", "1–20", "401", "403",
              "maxAttempts: 4", "backoffMs: 800", "```yaml", "```", "| Setting | Default | Valid range | Behavior |",
              "|---|---:|---:|---|", "initial delivery", "never retried", "greater than one",
              "worker restarts", "measured in seconds", "measured in milliseconds"]:
    print(f"  present {probe!r}: {probe in new}")

print("non-ascii chars in output:", sorted({c for c in new if ord(c) > 127}))
print("non-ascii chars in input :", sorted({c for c in orig if ord(c) > 127}))
print("trailing newline exact:", new.endswith("\n") and not new.endswith("\n\n"))
print("input unchanged:", orig == open("input.md", encoding="utf-8").read())

input.content:
import json
import subprocess
import sys

SCRIPT = ".agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py"


def run(args, cwd="."):
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SCRIPT, *args], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=cwd)
    return proc.returncode, proc.stdout.strip(), proc.stderr.strip()


code, out, err = run(["verify", "input.md", "output.md", "--scope=format", "--json"])
print("verify --json exit =", code)
print(out)
print(err)

code, out, err = run(["audit", "output.md", "--level", "3", "--scope=format", "--json"])
print("\naudit --json exit =", code)
data = json.loads(out)
print("keys:", list(data.keys()))
print("score:", json.dumps(data.get("score"), ensure_ascii=False)[:400])
print("status/coverage:", json.dumps(data.get("coverage"), ensure_ascii=False))
print("findings:", data.get("findings"))
print("shown_findings:", data.get("shown_findings"))
print("unscored:", json.dumps(data.get("unscored"), ensure_ascii=False))

git = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--porcelain", "input.md"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("\ngit status --porcelain input.md -> exit", git.returncode, "|", (git.stdout or git.stderr).strip()[:120])
